text:
olivia.h: Heads-up team — incoming pen-test next Wed 09:30 PT. Final scope ask from vendor: keystore/presign flow, ephemeral RBAC for assessors, audit-forwarding SLA, and clear retest tempo.

rahul.k: Proposed RBAC window: 09:00-11:00 PT (2h). Need named approvers for emergency elevates and a rollback owner. Can we keep an explicit allowlist for who can assume the assessor role?

sam.t: +1. Use ephemeral pipeline (assessor-bake -> assessor-role) and require MFA for any elevate during the window. Ops, please reserve a 4h retest block exactly 7 days after fixes are merged.

jin.w: Presign flow note: presign-lambda calls keystore-proxy which requests kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext and kms:Sign for metadata. We must not grant kms:Decrypt to assessor principals. I'll publish a minimal policy in the runbook. Example snippet I'll include: 
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext", "kms:Sign", "s3:PutObject"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/EX-KEY-01"
}
```

nisha.c: Can we enforce a 15m TTL on presigned URLs and restrict destination S3 prefix to `pen-tests/exports/`? Also require the presign lambda to stamp a `request_id` tag on objects for audit correlation.

jin.w: Yup — TTL 15m and prefix enforced in the lambda. I'll add object tagging (`x-amz-meta-request-id`) and a CloudTrail correlate step to the runbook.

ops-bot: [ephemeral-bake] scheduled: ephemeral/assessor-bake-2026-04-07T16:00Z -> expires 2026-04-07T20:00Z.

rahul.k: KMS audit requirement: key usage must appear in CloudTrail and the key-usage feed should forward to the audit index within 5m. If a finding touches key material, auto-label `requires-kms-review` and page the KMS SME for sev>=high.

olivia.h: Intake process: vendor report -> intake form -> webhook -> create vuln ticket on project `pen-2026-q2`. Ticket must capture severity, repro steps, affected resources, owner, expected retest ETA, and flags (`requires-kms-review`, `rbac`).

sam.t: For retest coordination: reserve an environment snapshot and a keystore snapshot at time-of-fix. Keep snapshots for 72h post-retest. Ops should produce a `snapshot-manifest.json` that contains keystorectl snapshot id and CloudTrail export hash.

jin.w: Runbook will include commands: 
```
# create keystore snapshot
keystorectl snapshot --id $RUN_ID --output snapshot-$RUN_ID.tar.gz
# export cloudtrail selection for timeframe
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time $START --end-time $END --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/EX-KEY-01 > ct-$RUN_ID.json
```

nisha.c: Also add a validation step to assert no unintended Decrypt calls happened from assessor principals: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=assessor-external | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="Decrypt")'
```

olivia.h: IR policy: if vendor demonstrates a live exploit or data exfil, immediately escalate to oncall-SOC and open an incident in #incidents. That becomes an IR run and is quarantined from normal remediation cycles. Include SOC contact card and escalation matrix in runbook.

rahul.k: I'll own the escalation mapping and approver list. I'll also add GH label-to-pager rules so `requires-kms-review`+high -> page KMS SME.

sam.t: Ops action: reserve retest window, snapshot retention policy, and ensure ephemeral bake job is green before vendor kickoff. I'll confirm reservations in the calendar.

jin.w: Action: publish runbook + intake form + example IAM policy by EOD tomorrow. Will post link here. Runbook will include sample queries, presign policy, and snapshot manifest format.

nisha.c: One small ask — add a checklist to capture evidence for each fix (screenshots, trace ids, cloudtrail slices). That will speed up retest verification.

olivia.h: Final action items: Jin (runbook, form, presign policy), Rahul (escalation mapping, allowlist), Sam (reserve retest window + snapshot retention), Nisha (evidence checklist). I'll send the scope doc to vendor after we confirm the ephemeral bake. Thanks all.
